purpose: Deterministic disposable Cockpit fixture for exhaustive browser-first evidence collection.

prerequisites.proof: process name and owner token equal atlas-20260912
prerequisites.onFailure: STOP; retain process listing and do not open browser

prerequisites.proof: profile path is atlas-20260912-browser-profile and is not the user profile
session id is atlas-20260912-herdr and protected session default is untouched
browser can set 1440x900 and 1024x640 device viewport
prerequisites.onFailure: STOP; no screenshots; retain viewport error

prerequisites.proof: fixture root marker owner=atlas-20260912-fixture; no unowned files
prerequisites.onFailure: STOP and escalate; never delete unowned files

actions.assert: all topology.repositories and topology.files exist with declared status
exactly 2 spaces, 4 tabs, 8 panes, 4 agents, 2 projects
documents, imports, pending feedback, and both eligibility states exist
only allowedTabs are open in browserContext

readinessChecks.assert: repositories=2 && every repository has changed, untracked, binary, markdown, and code fixtures

collectionMatrix.requiredScreenshots: Each matrix cell requires one screenshot at each viewport; filename includes cell id and viewport.

cells.observableProof: both spaces, four tabs, active panes and agent badges are visible
cells.retry: reload once, then reselect space; if counts remain wrong retain DOM snapshot and mark INCONCLUSIVE

cells.observableProof: changed, untracked, binary, markdown, and code files are visible for both repositories
cells.retry: refresh repository view once; if status differs retain repository receipt and mark INCONCLUSIVE

cells.observableProof: context documents and imported sources are visible and attributed to the active project
cells.retry: reopen context panel once; if imports absent retain event log and mark INCONCLUSIVE

cells.observableProof: two pending annotated feedback items are visible with their targets
cells.retry: navigate only via fixture tab once; if pending state changes retain network/state dump and mark INCONCLUSIVE

cells.observableProof: eligible target is actionable and ineligible target is visibly blocked with reason
cells.retry: reopen delivery chooser once; if eligibility is ambiguous retain chooser state and mark INCONCLUSIVE

escalateWhen: protected session appears in touched resources
browser tab cannot be proven fixture-owned

gates: all screenshots and machine evidence flushed
protected session default remains present and unchanged
fixture root marker and ownership receipts still readable

actions.assert: delete only paths under fixture root with matching owner marker
all gates=true and protected resources untouched
